Module com.mycompany.urbanlegends
Package game

Class Player

java.lang.Object
game.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game with attributes such as name, position, and a list of active missions. Provides methods for managing player movement and mission progress.
Author:
joxan, melani, fabian, jorge, ismael
